mechanism.claim: opposite BVOL and DVOL repricing with a quiet first half, extreme absolute OI repricing, and a late-hour BTC breakout identifies delayed inventory release whose second-half direction should persist for six hours
mechanism.side: sign of the completed-hour second-half BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: CVLIR is a quiet-to-breakout phase transition conditioned on absolute OI repricing; it neither requires CVDAR absorption nor uses CVDR's moderate full-hour displacement
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the clock requires cross-venue option-vol disagreement and a within-hour quiet-to-tail transition absent from the frozen REX, kimchi, Rank7, and Markov sleeve clocks

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility: normalized BVOL and DVOL bodies have strictly opposite nonzero signs
clock.price_source: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T), split at exact minute 30
clock.quiet_first_half: absolute first-half return <= strictly-prior 720h q40 with 672 observations
clock.late_breakout: nonzero absolute second-half return >= strictly-prior 720h q90 with 672 observations
clock.oi: raw-time backward-asof observations at T and T-60m, each age<=5m; absolute one-hour change >= strictly-prior 720h q75 with 672 observations
clock.funding: not a signal input; opened only for later exact PnL accounting
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.intrahour_price: reuse hash-bound OLIAH completed-hour intrahour snapshot
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
